title: Setup → user record: Details hides the saved Locale and ban state, and Platform Role reads lowercase "user" (#27521 row 13)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 13 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator opening a user. What happens: the Details section shows only created/updated, so a saved Locale is invisible; there is no Banned badge or ban reason anywhere on the record, so a banned user looks active; "Platform Role: user" is the lowercase value. Reach: every administrator opening a user. (The cut tab strip is fixed in PR #27849.)

## Mechanism

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: record page sections and highlight fields omit `locale`, `banned` and `ban_reason`; the role option labels are the raw values.
- The page layout is in `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`.

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the source line is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

Locale, ban state and ban reason on Details (ban state also as a header badge or highlight); a label for the platform role.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A user with a saved Locale shows it on Details.
- [ ] A banned user shows a Banned state and the ban reason on the record.
- [ ] Platform Role reads a label (e.g. "User"), not the lowercase value.

Refs #27521
